description: This file defines the AggregateFunction interface used in Spark SQL for implementing custom aggregation functions. It includes methods for initializing, updating, merging, and producing results from aggregation states.

classes.name: AggregateFunction
classes.description: Interface for a function that produces a result value by aggregating over multiple input rows, supporting partial aggregation and serialization.

methods.name: newAggregationState
methods.description: Initialize state for an aggregation, supporting null state for null input.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update the aggregation state with a new input row.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merge two partial aggregation states into one.

methods.name: produceResult
methods.description: Produce the final aggregation result from the intermediate state.
